name: deterministic
justification: It constrains how the service may behave during future decisions. The operating-mode restriction is explicit and stable.

name: json_only
justification: It is a direct output/input format constraint on future system behavior. The constraint is explicit and enforceable.

name: no randomness
justification: It explicitly restricts decision behavior and is stable over time. The constraint is enforceable as an operating rule.

name: no assumptions
justification: It constrains how inputs are interpreted in future decisions. The rule is explicit and stable.

name: do NOT modify decisions
description: The service does NOT modify decisions.
justification: It sets a stable boundary on what the service is allowed to do. The constraint is explicit and enforceable.

name: do NOT generate insights
description: The service does NOT generate insights.
justification: It defines a stable operational boundary for the service. The constraint is explicit and enforceable.

name: do NOT update weights
description: The service does NOT update weights.
justification: It is an explicit restriction on system behavior that remains stable across contexts. The constraint is enforceable.

name: do NOT evaluate performance
description: The service does NOT evaluate performance.
justification: It sets a stable behavioral boundary and is explicitly stated. The constraint is enforceable.

name: do NOT override Meta Controller decisions
description: The service does NOT override Meta Controller decisions.
justification: It is an explicit boundary on decision authority and affects future control behavior. The rule is stable and enforceable even though the Meta Controller itself is not fully defined here.
